entries.sentence: The NHS lists unusual vaginal bleeding, including bleeding during or after sex, between periods or after the menopause, as the main symptom.
entries.note: first pass: written from the retrieved search summary text; attributed to the page(s) whose title matches (summaries blend pages)

entries.sentence: Other symptoms are changes in vaginal discharge, pain during sex, and pelvic or lower back pain.
entries.note: first pass: written from the retrieved search summary text; attributed to the page(s) whose title matches (summaries blend pages)

entries.sentence: Early cervical cancer often causes no symptoms, so the NHS says that symptoms appearing between regular screening appointments should not wait for the next one.
entries.note: first pass: written from the retrieved search summary text; attributed to the page(s) whose title matches (summaries blend pages)

entries.sentence: A GP appointment is the route: the NHS advises being checked if symptoms change, get worse or do not feel normal for the person.
entries.note: first pass: written from the retrieved search summary text; attributed to the page(s) whose title matches (summaries blend pages)

entries.sentence: Cancer Research UK notes that these symptoms are common and have many other causes, so they do not confirm cancer.

entries.sentence: Screening cannot assess symptoms.

entries.sentence: The usual next steps are an examination and, if needed, referral for a closer look at the cervix.

entries.sentence: NHS 111 Wales says nearly all cervical cancers are linked to infection with certain high-risk types of the human papillomavirus (HPV).

entries.sentence: A Newcastle hospitals leaflet adds that HPV is very common and that most people clear the virus without problems.

entries.sentence: Two measures target this chain of events.

entries.sentence: All children aged 12 to 13 are offered the HPV vaccine, and everyone with a cervix aged 25 to 64 is invited for regular cervical screening.

entries.sentence: This includes women and anyone else who has a cervix.

entries.sentence: Screening looks for HPV and abnormal cells before cancer develops.

entries.sentence: Screening is a way of finding changes early.

entries.sentence: It is not a diagnostic test for cancer, and one source notes that Pap smears screen for, but do not diagnose, cervical pre-cancers.

entries.sentence: Diagnosis often begins with an abnormal screening result.

entries.sentence: Colposcopy is usually the first step after one: the cervix is looked at closely, and a small punch biopsy is common.

entries.sentence: A loop excision (LLETZ) or cone biopsy can also give tissue to examine.

entries.sentence: Colposcopy does not establish a diagnosis of cancer on its own.

entries.sentence: A biopsy does.

entries.sentence: If cancer is found, tests such as an MRI scan, a PET-CT scan or a chest X-ray may be used to see how far it has spread.

entries.sentence: Doctors describe this as the stage, using the FIGO system, which has four stages numbered 1 to 4 based on the size of the cancer and whether it has spread.

entries.sentence: Treatment usually includes surgery, chemotherapy or radiotherapy, and depends on the size and type of the cancer and where it is.
entries.note: first pass: written from the retrieved search summary text; attributed to the page(s) whose title matches (summaries blend pages)

entries.sentence: Surgery is the main treatment for early disease, and the types include LLETZ, cone biopsy, hysterectomy and trachelectomy.
entries.note: first pass: written from the retrieved search summary text; attributed to the page(s) whose title matches (summaries blend pages)

entries.sentence: Radiotherapy may be used instead of surgery for someone not fit for a big operation or general anaesthetic, or after surgery to reduce the risk of the cancer coming back.

entries.sentence: Cancer Research UK says chemotherapy can be given at the same time as radiotherapy, called chemoradiotherapy, for stage 1B2 to stage 4A cervical cancer, and that cisplatin is the most common drug.

entries.sentence: For stage 2, chemoradiotherapy is the main treatment, sometimes with surgery.

entries.sentence: In stage 4A a few people may be offered a pelvic exenteration, a major operation.

entries.sentence: For cancer that has spread, treatment can include the immunotherapy drug pembrolizumab with chemotherapy, with or without the targeted drug bevacizumab.

entries.sentence: Small cell cancer of the cervix is rare and is treated differently.
